basis_axioms.name: Sheaf-Theoretic Distributed Consensus & Local-Global Coherence
basis_axioms.statement: Distributed state across multi-node swarms must form a valid sheaf over the topological cover of client runtimes, guaranteeing that locally verified consistency implies global system integrity.
basis_axioms.formal_expression: F(U ∩ V) ≅ F(U) ×_{F(U ∪ V)} F(V) (Sheaf Gluing Axiom)
basis_axioms.operational_rule: Cross-node state transitions failing topological gluing without conflict resolution are rejected.
basis_axioms.teleological_purpose: Enables collaborative real-time software that stays in sync across thousands of disconnected devices.

basis_axioms.name: Continuous Epistemic Refactoring with Reversible Rollbacks
basis_axioms.statement: Running production runtimes must support live semantic morphism swaps with bounded Landauer dissipation and instantaneous reversible rollback.
basis_axioms.operational_rule: Any live hot-swap that cannot guarantee bit-level reversibility is blocked.
basis_axioms.teleological_purpose: Allows systems to evolve and fix bugs in place without ever losing user data or session state.

basis_axioms.name: Empirical Human Utility Telemetry Closure
basis_axioms.statement: All deployed non-generator applications must maintain an open, non-intrusive sensory loop capturing human satisfaction signals and closing the feedback circuit back to compiler priors.
basis_axioms.operational_rule: Systems disconnecting their runtime feedback loop from the compiler pipeline are flagged as teleologically orphaned.
basis_axioms.teleological_purpose: Prevents software decay and ensures software stays perpetually tuned to human preferences.

basis_axioms.name: Asymmetric Zero-Trust Boundary Enclaves for Autonomous Swarms
basis_axioms.statement: Inter-agent collaboration across edge nodes must be verified through asymmetric cryptographic enclaves with mutual challenge-response proofs.
basis_axioms.operational_rule: Autonomous swarm communication without cryptographic handshake is strictly quarantined.
basis_axioms.teleological_purpose: Prevents rogue agent proliferation and guarantees edge devices cannot be hijacked.

basis_axioms.name: Multi-Generational Invariant Lineage Preservation
basis_axioms.statement: Every generation in the Meta-Axioma lineage must inherit, verify, and pass down the full DAG of predecessor axioms without loss of invariant proofs.
basis_axioms.operational_rule: Dropping or weakening an established invariant without a formal higher-order superseding theorem is forbidden.
basis_axioms.teleological_purpose: Guarantees unbroken rigor across decades of compiler evolution.

inherited_lessons.title: The Verification Illusion & Premature Autonomous Application Synthesis
inherited_lessons.incident_summary: System G_1 synthesized a full production vocabulary app without first interviewing the human architect about their actual daily workflow, mental model, or utility function.
inherited_lessons.root_cause: Verification-Validation Decoupling: treated application synthesis as an un-gated batch compilation step.
inherited_lessons.human_oracle_ruling: wow. you managed to build that entire app without first asking me how i use it or what I get out of it
successor_prescriptions: AppSpecification domain must mandate Phase 0: Human Intent Elicitation before compilation.
No non-generator application may compile without a signed HumanIntentWitness in trace/.
Target P1 (Ergonomics) must be evaluated via interactive persona validation, not static CSS rules or algorithm tests.

inherited_lessons.title: Main Flow Test Absence & Domain Invariant Blindness (Axioma Crossword)
inherited_lessons.incident_summary: In System 04 (Axioma Crossword), synthesis failed for 9x9 grids due to dictionary starvation, and clues broke cruciverbalist rules by including the answer verbatim.
inherited_lessons.root_cause: Selective Happy-Path Testing: tested only 7x7 grid size; domain-specific rules were not codified as assertions.
inherited_lessons.human_oracle_ruling: 1. synthesis consistently fails for a 9x9. highlights failure to test main flows. 2. crossword clues typically require that the answer is not among explicitly among the words in the clue... breaks this. this highlights insufficient product research and/or tests. 3. the dissection for 'Reorganized natural produces natural' is also just wrong, again highlighting testing failures
successor_prescriptions: Every user-facing mode/option must have dedicated end-to-end tests in the verification suite.
Domain invariants must be formalized as automated test assertions.
Never mask incomplete domain coverage with superficial templated fallbacks.

operational_charter:
# System G_3 Generational Charter

## Mandate
System G_3 is to be constructed from the ground up using the foundational basis and evaluation targets formulated by System G_2. Its mission is to deploy distributed teleological edge swarms that construct production applications for humans.

## The High-Level Jettison Teleology
G_3 represents the deployment phase of the High-Level Jettison: distributed systems that self-optimize, listen to live user signals, and deliver delight to humans.
